capabilityReconciliation.note: Discovery is REAL here (534 sites) — unlike the email specimen, where the effect was absent. The mapping is still unresolved, for a different reason at each of the other two namespaces. (1) No governed effect is declared: the specimen governs only communication.email.send. (2) No enforcement action corresponds: GOVERNED_ACTION_TYPES has 112 entries of which 7 are delete-like (vertical_delete, contact_delete, organization_delete, sales_pipeline_deal_delete, sales_pipeline_shell_delete, onboarding_workspace_delete, vault_item_delete) and NONE is filesystem-scoped. A naive matcher would also find a bare 'delete' near these — that string is a risk-escalation KEYWORD in policy.ts's HIGH list beside 'destroy'/'drop'/'terminate', not a registered capability. Two different populations live in that surface, and conflating them is a second way to assert a governed effect that does not exist. Every one of the 534 sites also carries blast radius NOT ASSESSED (scope=None), which is never read as scoped.
